lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Lourdes, it's Jorge. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the vegetables went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about fruit at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Kind of down this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What happened with the vegetables?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, good! I didn't miss a day.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've picked your days.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You feel like you have to do something.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You think you can do it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can do the band while I watch my novela.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've noticed it makes a difference.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. My back was hurting so I didn't push it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Next week I want you to do the band exercises 5 times.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 8. Maybe 9.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 8 and not a 5?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My arms feel stronger already.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll do it right when I wake up, before anything else.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 4 out of 4 days, the hard part was the late dinners, and next week you're going to do the band exercises 5 times. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

flags.reason: Participant's fruit-at-night question was raised and never answered or scheduled.
Participant said she was 'kind of down'; coach replied 'Right' and moved on without exploring mood.
Coach set a 5-day goal directly after participant named 3 days; no collaboration or permission sought.
Summary says 4 of 4 days and late dinners were the hard part; participant never said these, undermining accuracy.

score.summary: Jorge built good momentum with reflections and autonomy-supporting language, and the participant voiced several change statements. However, he overrode her 3-day plan with a directive 5-day goal, skipped her 'kind of down' cue and fruit question, and his summary misstated what she said.
strengths: Line 14: 'It's completely your call' reinforces autonomy.
Line 34: 'You know your schedule better than anyone' affirms her expertise.
Line 46-48: Good use of scaling follow-up and barrier question elicited a specific morning plan (line 49).
coaching_tips: Line 42: After she said 3 days (line 33), ask permission or invite her to choose the number rather than setting 5 times.
Line 6: When she says 'kind of down', pause and explore it with an open question before moving on.
Line 4: Return to her fruit-at-night question, or schedule it for next call.
Line 50: Summarize only what she said; confirm rather than add details she did not raise.
Line 10: Avoid reflections that attribute feelings or ideas she has not expressed.
